findings.message: caid-output project has engineer-authored code but the pipeline convergence artefacts are missing: CODE_REVIEW_FINDINGS.json (Phase 4b), ARCHIVIST_DRAFTS.json (Phase 6a). Run `caid post-build --project-dir <path>` to close the L-219/L-222/L-224 self-improvement loop.
findings.proposed_lesson_title: Pipeline convergence artefacts missing after engineer-authored build — self-improvement loop skipped

findings.message: Integration connector touches an external system without declaring required controls: audit, schema validation, retry policy, error normalisation, observability/tracing, security policy.
findings.proposed_lesson_title: External integration connectors must carry governance controls
